description: This file defines the SecurityContext class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, implementing the PluginHost::ISecurity interface. It manages security contexts including payload handling, permission checks for websocket upgrades, requests, and JSONRPC messages, and token management. It also contains an inner Payload class for JSON serialization of URL, user, and hash information.

classes.name: SecurityContext
classes.description: Implements security context handling, permission checks, and token management based on access control lists.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: A JSON container class for serializable URL, user, and hash data related to security context.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific websocket path, request, or JSONRPC message is permitted.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Retrieves the security token associated with the context.
